rappel_detail.anchor: not described; carry snow, ice and rock anchor material
rappel_detail.station: Early in the technical section of Curtis Ridge, on the way up.
rappel_detail.notes: A committing rappel on the ascent that marks the point of no return: once the rope is pulled, the way off is over the top. The descent is the Emmons-Winthrop walk-off, with no rappels.

set.rappels: 1 committing rappel early in the technical section on the way up; the descent down the Emmons-Winthrop route has none
